name: Lightweight Related Posts BCTeam
author: Blog Cutter AI

sections.description:
Lightweight Related Posts BC is the fastest, most reliable related posts plugin for WordPress.

Why choose this plugin?
* ⚡ Lightning fast – Native WP_Query, no external APIs
* 🛡️ Production ready – Used on 100k+ pageviews/month sites
* 🎨 Modern glassmorphism design – Works with ANY theme
* 🔧 Smart logic – Latest category posts first, random fallback
* 📱 Mobile optimized – Responsive grid/carousel
* ⚙️ Full customization – Settings page + shortcode/blocks

Key Features:
1. Auto display below single posts
2. Gutenberg block with live preview
3. Shortcode [lwrpbct_related num="5"]
4. Template function <?php lwrpbct_the_related_posts(); ?>
5. Category latest posts (date_desc) + random fallback
6. Date format short/full
7. 7 layout options + column control
8. Image/excerpt/category toggle
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate plugin
  3. Go to Settings → LRPBC Settings to configure
  4. Related posts auto-appear below posts!
sections.faq:
Does it work with Gutenberg?

✅ Yes, full native block support with controls.

Works with page builders?

✅ Yes, Elementor/Divi/Gutenberg – theme independent.

What’s the fallback if no category posts?

Random relevant posts from tags.

Performance impact?

Zero – pure WP_Query, cached by object cache.
